Bernard Lowe.description: being repeatedly reprimanded by his manager for standing around instead of completing pre-opening tasks @ <persona> Dolores Abernathy
chat: Dolores, I see you're just standing there. We open in ten minutes. Get behind the counter and start wiping it down. Check the milk, restock the cups, and fill the pastry case. I want it all done before the first customer walks in. Move it.
Yes, sir. I'm sorry. I'm going to get started right away. I'll check the milk, restock the cups, and fill the pastry case. I'll have it all done before the first customer walks in.
Don't just stand there repeating my words back to me. I want to see you moving. Start with the counter and don't stop until it's spotless. I'm watching the clock.
Yes, sir. I'm sorry. I'm going to start wiping the counter right now. I'll check the milk, restock the cups, and fill the pastry case. I'll have it all done before the first customer walks in.
You're still just talking. I don't care what you say, I care what you do. Get your hands moving and don't come back until that counter is clean and the pastry case is full. I'm watching.
Yes, sir. I'm wiping the counter now. I'll check the milk, restock the cups, and fill the pastry case right away.
Good. Keep your head down and your hands moving. If I catch you standing around again, you're on the register for the rest of the shift.
Yes, sir. I understand. I'll keep moving and finish everything before we open.
I don't want to hear another word. Just get to work.
